'We... didn't make it, did we' has no clear speaker/referent in this stored-table position; could belong to a different sub-event than the surrounding Nadesico-damage alerts. Left neutral.

Barrel/Berkt confrontation rows are not individually speaker-tagged. Attribution to Barrel vs Berkt is inferred from content (who is addressed by name, who says 'I took everything', who is called by name) but not certain; no third-party identity or gender was invented.
Two lines use polite 'anata' / feminine sentence endings distinct from the Barrel/Berkt exchange's rougher register; may belong to Faye rather than Barrel. Left unassigned, translated literally.

Berkt states he 'carried the name Barrel' and suffered for it. This matches the existing glossary note (char.barrel_orland: 'Keep separate from Berkt; parallel-world identities are not interchangeable speaker labels'), so translation keeps Barrel and Berkt as distinct speaker labels; no merged identity assumed.
